content.rationale: The record verb: without --to (yrmxrywl), with no id at all (ouyrkmlr) or with no path (R1) it refuses and places nothing; an argument the form does not name refuses, named (R2), and its arguments are recognized in any order (R3); a named path that cannot be placed — no working-copy edit, or not owned by the target (R4) — refuses, named, placing nothing; when the --to id maps to neither a valid node nor the root it refuses before placing, naming the id (D21, tsspuwzo, xtmprysl) and touching nothing (qyynqqpx); when the named target maps to no node it refuses, naming the id, and places nothing (uzlvzrpv); otherwise it brackets the recording through M-markers-capture — the lifecycle table's recording case (S5-lifecycle) — reading the working copy's changed paths through M-jj-status (S3-status), attributing with M-node-own over the resolved document (the ownership rule, D2, xzxtxymq, S2-own) with D6's placement rule (roqpxulw) deciding which change owns which edit, and moving the named paths into the named change through M-jj-place (S3-place). Purpose is named, never inferred (D13, rvyrosmp); it creates no node (lypvkskv), lands no edit outside an owning change (xklsyrrv), and writes nothing on success (O7-record, wvqzoqvx). It resolves the id through M-node-resolve (hence M-node-load), names the file through M-store-path, reads through M-store-read across the runner (M-jj), builds its refusals through M-refusal, takes the injected context (M-context, M-context-injection), and returns its lines for the envelope to write (M-output-return) under M-route's handler shape — the table's Verb type, which its signature must match — carrying its own --help text (xlvoxmyl/rwlywqrk, per oqnsuzqu) — answered before the store is taken, so a root-less context still answers it (H1, qtqnuqxo), as do the form's refusals. I1-serde (orrvsxqq) fixes the JSON layer the module is written against — serde and serde_json, the crate's own `Value` and the derive. It takes the store through the context's fallible accessor for the capture bracket, after the surface is answered (S3-root-required). The read's refusal site (S2-read-refusal-site, vollyzvn) is this invocation's: a target whose document cannot be read refuses, naming it. A recording answers its target even when the placement refuses (S5-record-named, wotmvzyt): the window it kept may hold work that landed before the refusal, so the marker is what undo reverts. The capture call is the recording bracket (M-markers-capture, okkvnnvm): it snapshots the target's owned paths and stores one journal entry, so record names the owned set it hands across.
